title: Best-practice for attaching hats/cosmetics to a stylized character head in Godot 4? Offset tuning keeps drifting
author: Prior-Meeting1645
selftext:
I’m building a cosmetic system for a game with Mixamo rigged creature characters that wear hats. 

Right now I attach the hat with a BoneAttachment3D on the Head bone plus a manual vertical offset scaled by the character’s size. It looks right in one test pose, but in-game the hat floats above the head (or sinks) depending on the character’s scale and animation  the offset method just isn’t right.

the character does have unusual proportions though,compared a human like a big round head, much larger than a normal humanoid, so the Mixamo Head / HeadTop\_End bones sit deep inside the visible head mesh they don’t line up with where the headtop actually is.

comments.author: aigamedev-ModTeam
comments.body: This post is not specific to AI based game development. See rule #1.
